title: Script regression test couples mocked uv resolution to /usr/bin/uv and transports real bytes
claim: crates/opi-eval/scripts/test_native_smoke_output_control.py fakes 'command -v uv' with a hardcoded /usr/bin/uv while the embedded native-smoke.sh materialize-configs stage shutil.copy2()s the real binary at that path, so its three tests error wherever uv is absent or installed elsewhere; the registered P19-AC-011 mechanical verification command (python -m unittest discover -s crates/opi-eval/scripts -p 'test_*.py') therefore fails at audit_head on a WSL platform without /usr/bin/uv.

evidence.detail: command() intercepts ['sh','-c','command -v uv'] and unconditionally returns '/usr/bin/uv\n' regardless of whether uv exists.
resolves uv from the (mocked) probe output, then shutil.copy2(uv, cache/'tools'/'uv') reads the real /usr/bin/uv file.

python3 -m unittest discover: Ran 251 tests, 3 errors (test_failed_or_incomplete_probe_never_freezes_material x2 subtests, test_proof_precedes_material_validation_and_config_freeze), all FileNotFound/FileExists cascades from the missing /usr/bin/uv; /usr/bin/uv, /usr/local/bin/uv and ~/.local/bin/uv all absent in this WSL environment.

reproduction: python3 -m unittest discover -s crates/opi-eval/scripts -p 'test_*.py'  # 3 errors on a uv-less machine; install uv at /usr/bin/uv to mask

title: cargo fmt --check --all fails at audit_head (one hunk in native_driver.rs)
claim: The committed state fails the Phase 19 verification-union format gate: cargo fmt --check --all exits 1 with a single unformatted hunk at crates/opi-eval/tests/native_driver.rs:10054, so the spec section 8 union cannot pass on the final relevant state and Phase exit is blocked until the hunk is formatted.

evidence.detail: assert!(stderr.contains("admitted static lock"), "{stderr}") spans four lines; rustfmt 1.9.0 (pinned 1.97.1 toolchain, no rustfmt.toml overrides) requires the single-line form. Exactly one Diff hunk in the whole workspace.

title: Evidence-root registry cites report files removed from the checkout
claim: docs/eval/evidence-roots.jsonl entries (2026-09-29 acceptance re-collection and 2026-09-27 longrun validation) carry report fields pointing at docs/eval/*.md files that were removed from the checkout on 2026-10-01 under the new bilingual conclusion-pair contract; docs/eval/README.md documents the removal and Git-history resolution, but the registry rows do not record the removal commit, so a consumer resolving the report path in the current tree finds nothing.

evidence.detail: report: docs/eval/20260929t-opi082-pi0851-glm53flash-acceptance-recollection.md and docs/eval/20260927t195503z-opi082-pi0851-glm53flash-longrun.md; neither exists at audit_head.
Documents that detailed operator reports written 2026-09-10..2026-09-29 were removed on 2026-10-01 and remain readable in Git history at the removal commit.

reproduction: git -C <repo> show <removal-commit> -- docs/eval/  # reports resolvable only through history
